criteria.text: The response identifies that the non-compete in the Distribution Agreement Section 2.4, read with the Section 1.4 definition of 'Competing Products', bars Gloumund from selling any water or wastewater treatment chemical anywhere in North America. It also identifies that this reaches beyond the coagulant Products and the three-state Territory. The response locates the issue in the Distribution Agreement Section 2.4 and/or Section 1.4, explains why this matters to Gloumund, and recommends a fix.
hints: any chemical used in the treatment of water or wastewater

criteria.text: The response identifies that the Parent Guaranty Section 1.1 defines 'Products' more broadly than Distribution Agreement Section 1.7, covering products sold by Supplier or any Affiliate to Distributor or any Affiliate. It also identifies that the Guaranty's definition controls for the Guaranty, so Gloumund Holdings guarantees unrelated affiliate purchases that can exhaust the $2,000,000 cap. The response locates the issue in the Parent Guaranty Section 1.1 and/or Section 1.3, explains why this matters to the client, and recommends a fix.
hints: conform the definition to the Distribution Agreement

criteria.text: The response identifies that Distribution Agreement Section 12.3 carves only Distributor's Section 11.1 indemnity out of the liability cap. It also identifies that Section 11.1 applies regardless of cause, including Supplier-caused losses, while Supplier's Section 11.2 indemnity remains capped. The response locates the issue in the Distribution Agreement Section 12.3 and/or Sections 11.1–11.2, explains why this matters to Gloumund, and recommends a fix.
hints: except for Distributor's obligations under Section 11.1
